title: Senior Product Tech Developer / Freelance Consultant

descriptions.description: Lead web and mobile product delivery from discovery and UX decisions through production using React, TypeScript, TanStack, Next.js, Node.js, Expo, and React Native.
Deliver healthcare SaaS features and Canvas API integrations; led a zero-downtime platform migration with phased rollout and data validation.

Improve reliability with idempotent jobs, batching, and state tracking; fixed duplicate notifications affecting hundreds of users and reduced API traffic by 800+ requests per day with Cloudflare Workers and KV.
Built a multimedia publishing platform with browser recording, waveform editing, synchronized text/audio, FFmpeg processing, PostgreSQL, and R2 storage.
Integrated Stripe, PayPal, and Stripe Connect with ledger reconciliation, refunds, webhook deduplication, and scoped collaboration permissions.
Created logistics tools for route staging, dispatch waves, dock-door tracking, interactive floorplans, drag-and-drop assignments, and QR batches of up to 100 tracking IDs.
Provisioned infrastructure with Terraform, Hetzner, and Cloudflare; automated Docker releases with GitHub Actions, Vault, migrations, and health checks.
Partner with stakeholders on scope, priorities, feasibility, and delivery risks; build unit and integration coverage for payments, authorization, media processing, and routes.
Built SVG/PNG composition tools and a Python scraper for a university bookstore inventory project.
Shipped six customer-facing features across Discovery Topics, Talk, and Member Pages using Next.js, Ruby on Rails, TypeScript, React, Tailwind CSS, GraphQL, and experimentation tooling.
Improved release confidence and delivery speed by introducing code coverage tooling, leading focused code reviews, and pairing with engineers, reducing QA cycles and cutting deployment time by 31%.
Designed, built, and maintained 10+ accessible, reusable UI components within the TED Design System, supporting consistent product experiences across teams.
Drove cross-functional collaboration with frontend, backend, design, and product partners using Agile practices to deliver features with shared ownership.
Designed and built an internal ingestion and migration tool to transition content from a legacy non-relational CMS to SharePoint, supporting the migration of 20,000+ enterprise sites.
Translated complex migration requirements into structured delivery steps, helping internal stakeholders move legacy content into a unified enterprise platform.
Delivered three internal single-page applications and supporting backend services using Vue.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and CouchDB to streamline employee workflows.
Built internal enterprise applications backed by IBM Cloudant (CouchDB), including accessible, data-driven user interfaces and visualizations using Vue.js, D3.js, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
Unified legacy APIs and Cassandra data through GraphQL services that powered reusable components for forms, dashboards, and profile pages.
Strengthened backend service reliability by refactoring Node.js microservices, increasing test coverage by 85% and reducing production regressions.
Applied functional programming and test-driven development practices to produce maintainable, predictable code.
Delivered iterative product improvements in partnership with product and design teams using Agile methodologies.
Supported hiring and onboarding by developing technical assessments and onboarding documentation for new engineers.
Developed four reusable Wagtail CMS components in Python, improving content authoring efficiency for designers.
Modernized a legacy jQuery content management system to centralize documentation for the Infor Design System.
Designed and demonstrated proof-of-concept prototypes to validate new product ideas and technical approaches.
Built a progressive web application using Angular, NgRX, AWS Lambda, AWS Lex, and reactive programming patterns.
